body.heading: Where in the world is South Korea?
paragraphs: South Korea is a country in Eastern Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of South Korea is Seoul.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in South Korea is Korean.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of South Korea is the South Korean won.

body.heading: How big is South Korea?
paragraphs: South Korea covers about 100,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Kyrgyzstan.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Seoul's grandest palace has guards in colourful Joseon-era uniforms, a throne hall and a secret garden — rent a hanbok outfit and entry is free.
Jeju is Korea's beloved holiday island — a volcanic land of lava tubes, waterfalls, the Sunrise Peak crater and Hallasan, the country's highest mountain.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find South Korea on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: South Korea in one breath: a country in Eastern Asia, capital Seoul, where people speak Korean and pay with the South Korean won.
